state.read.name: state.read
state.read.title: Read BME Primary state
state.read.description: Reads conversation, recall, planner, or vector-job state from the selected Authority Primary.

state.command.name: state.command
state.command.title: Commit BME Primary state
state.command.description: Applies one BME StateStore command with durable idempotency, physical CAS, and one atomic SQL transaction.

vector.manifest.name: vector.manifest
vector.manifest.title: Read BME derived vector status
vector.manifest.description: Reports the rebuildable v9 Trivium index status.

vector.apply.name: vector.apply
vector.apply.title: Apply BME derived vectors
vector.apply.description: Idempotently applies a committed VectorJob to the rebuildable v9 Trivium index.

recall.candidates.name: recall.candidates
recall.candidates.title: Read BME vector candidates
recall.candidates.description: Returns sanitized candidates from the rebuildable v9 Trivium index.
